Undercover service missing. In S3 'A Wanted (Inhu)man' and 'Devils You Know' (S3 episodes 3 to 4), Hunter wins a HYDRA fight club to get into Ward's HYDRA. Ward's second-in-command Kebo takes him in ('having secured his place in Hydra'), and he waits for orders and goes on a HYDRA mission with Kebo's men, hunting Ward from the inside. Later in S3 (episode 13) he and Bobbi are disavowed, which the existing Independent stage and 'left' S3 cover. The 'left' title stays.

The group ends with no stage. In S3, after 'The Team' (S3 episode 17), the Secret Warriors disband: Coulson suspects a member is under Hive's control, and Daisy (secretly Hive's) manipulates the team into breaking up. Joey leaves S.H.I.E.L.D., and Yo-Yo leaves and later returns. Lincoln refuses to leave and stays with S.H.I.E.L.D., hunting Daisy, until he dies in the finale. Coulson later talks with Yo-Yo about 'the disbanding of the Secret Warriors'. His last stage should be S.H.I.E.L.D., not the disbanded team.
